title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for allegedly taking photos of a 22-year-old woman he knew from college and using artificial intelligence to create obscene images and videos of her. Police say he operated several fake Instagram, Discord, and Facebook accounts, along with multiple Gmail IDs, to share the material anonymously. The woman reported the case to the North Delhi Cyber Police Station after receiving messages that her morphed images were being circulated.

Bansal, a BTech graduate from East Punjabi Bagh, told investigators he acted out of resentment after repeated insults from the woman. Police recovered one mobile phone, two SIM cards, and other digital evidence. Further investigation is under way.
title_en: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online
